svg.title: Slip-Guided Dual-Rate Visual–Acoustic State Estimation — Scheme II
svg.desc: Proposed modification to the triple-head estimator. A current causal audio summary and the previous recurrent state predict a coarse slip increment before fusion. Its de-normalized speed and runtime image age condition a scalar visual gate. Two separate cross-attention branches share a query from the delayed recurrent state. Their weighted features update a GRU once, followed by position, wrench and final-slip heads. Only the final hidden state is cached for the next event. True slip labels are used only for training supervision. All sensor icons and waveforms are illustrative.
svg.metadata: Architecture proposal; no training results or quantitative experimental data. Native SVG elements with editable text. 2026-11-24.
svg.text: Scheme II · Pre-fusion slip prior and gated dual-branch attention

g.text: Update audio and state at every event
Δtₖ = tₖ − tₖ₋₁ τₖ = tₖ − tⱼ

svg.text: SLOW VISUAL PATH · encode only when a new frame arrives
FAST ACOUSTIC PATH · current causal window at every event

g.text: Visual weight αₖ · Audio weight 1 − αₖ
Soft weights conditioned on motion and image age
hₖ → hₖ₋₁ at the next event

svg.text: Lprior = Huber(Δs̃ₖ, Δs*ₖ) · Ltotal = Lposition + Lwrench + Lslip + λprior Lprior
Ground truth supervises losses only. The gate uses the predicted prior; sg denotes stop-gradient.

g.text: Proposed architecture · no same-step slip feedback loop
Continuous events use actual Δt; independent samples use an explicit initialization policy. DeNorm uses training-set constants.
Shapes omit batch size · nominal event rate ≈150 Hz · mint: vision, blue: audio, amber: slip-guided gating
